Updated 18 minutes ago Australia Proposes Consulting Sector Overhaul After Scandals Australia proposed sweeping changes to the consulting sector including new powers to police the industry and impose larger fines for poor behavior, following a string of scandals in recent years. # Bloomberg Terminal: Finding Industry Information. A basic introduction to the Bloomberg Terminal. * Finding Public Company Information   Toggle Dropdown;). ## How Do I Find Industry Information? On any page in Bloomberg, type **BI** (which is a mnemonic for *Bloomberg Industries*) and then press GO. Select your industry, using the *All Industries* menu. Scroll or page down to see the full list of Bloomberg's industry sectors. After selecting your industry, choose the data  you would like to see, such as *Themes*, *Earnings*, *Markets*, etc., as categorized on the left side of the page. * << **Previous:** Finding Government Bond Information. * Last Updated: Oct 2, 2024 2:04 PM. * URL: https://libguides.nypl.org/BloombergTerminal.
